messages:
anna_cs: heads-up — noticed a batch import yesterday that bumped a bunch of trial accounts from 'onboarding' to 'engaged' and spiked the healthscore. could be misleading for renewal signals. anyone see the same? :thinking:

raj_eng: saw it, yep. looks like the CSV import sets `last_active` to import_date when the contact is populated. that cascades into the recency feature used by healthscore.

anna_cs: ugh. that explains it. want to avoid auto-promoting accounts until we have real product events. thinking we gate playbook actions on a telemetry-derived `product_event_count > 0` check.

jamie_research: +1 to gating. can we add a soft-flag so we can run a dry-run and see what playbook triggers would have fired? low-risk rollout.

carlos_ops: we already have playbook dry-run mode but it's per-rule. proposal: add a precondition layer 'telemetry_gate' that evaluates product_event_count and session_duration aggregates, defaulting to false for imported sources. that way rules don't kick until gate opens.

raj_eng: implementable. rough snippet for rule condition:```yaml
conditions:
  - source != "csv_import"
  - telemetry_gate:
      product_event_count: ">= 1"
      session_duration_seconds: ">= 60"
```

anna_cs: perfect. can playbook-bot run a sample against yesterday's import cohort and output how many would be blocked vs allowed? especially want counts by ARR band.

playbook-bot: dry-run complete for cohort id import-2026-03-22.
playbook-bot: total accounts: 2,742 — blocked by telemetry_gate: 2,195 (80%) — allowed: 547 (20%).
playbook-bot: breakdown by ARR buckets: <10k => 1,980 blocked / 472 allowed; 10k-100k => 185 blocked / 55 allowed; >100k => 30 blocked / 20 allowed.

jamie_research: that looks good. high-value accounts are less affected. suggests import noise mostly small accounts.

carlos_ops: rollout plan: (1) merge telemetry_gate into staging rules (dry-run) for 48 hours, (2) route 'high_value' ARR > 100k to bypass for monitoring, (3) run daily report in console for a week, (4) flip to enforcement after no regressions.

anna_cs: timeline ok. can someone add a healthscore note and a Slack alert when blocked fraction > 60% so CS knows to expect lower outreach counts?

raj_eng: will add the alert: `cs.playbook.telemetry_gate.block_pct` with threshold 60%. also adding attribute `import_source` to rule logs.

playbook-bot: alert rule created: cs.playbook.telemetry_gate.block_pct >= 60%. notifications: #customer-success, cs-ops-email, oncall-cs.

anna_cs: awesome — thanks all. i'll coordinate comms to enablement so AEs aren't surprised. :thumbsup:

jamie_research: quick checklist for post-rollout evaluation:
- sample prompts for CS to validate why accounts blocked
- aggregate product_event histograms
- manual review for ~50 random blocked accounts across ARR buckets

carlos_ops: i'll schedule the staging dry-run today at 16:00 PT. tagging @raj_eng for the merge.

raj_eng: merging in 10m, will post deploy confirmation. :rocket:

raj_eng: deploy done. staging dry-run started. logs in /playbook/dryruns/1837659999-staging-telemetry-gate.log

anna_cs: will watch the alert channel and pull a report tomorrow morning. thanks everyone! :eyes:
